languages.name: Kazakh
languages.notes: State language (Constitution Art.7); Russian 'officially used on equal grounds' — Kazakh is the state language, NOT co-official in the same clause. Latin-transition roadmap in progress (Cyrillic still dominant in print/schooling).

ekguru.recommendation: none — inventoried only. (EkGuru teaches Hindi TO Russian speakers via learn-hindi-for-russian-speakers — audience bridge, never a Russian course.)

languages.name: Russian
languages.notes: Officially used on equal grounds with Kazakh (Art.7) — still the interethnic lingua franca, though Kazakh-medium schooling keeps gaining. L1 ~3M (Russians 15% + others); L2 base very large, soft numbers.

ekguru.recommendation: Shared with Uzbekistan entry — one Northern Uzbek course serves all (notes on Kazakh-Uzbek contact).

languages.name: Uzbek
languages.notes: Concentrated south (Turkestan region, Shymkent). Code 'uzn' = NORTHERN Uzbek (SIL identity audit 2026-09-14 — not uzs). Latin in principle, Cyrillic common in practice.

ekguru.recommendation: watch — diaspora demand, script politics (Perso-Arabic vs exile-Latin use); shared planning with KG entry.

languages.name: Uyghur
languages.notes: Concentrated Jetisu/Almaty region (Zharkent/Panfilov). SIL Ref_Name keeps old spelling 'Uighur'. Soviet-era Cyrillic publishing, now mostly Perso-Arabic; exile-Latin exists — script choice is political, note it.

ekguru.recommendation: watch — dispersed urban; any Tatar action keys off the RU/Tatarstan entry (future batch).

languages.name: Tatar
languages.notes: Dispersed urban minority (Almaty/Karaganda). Cyrillic. Mishar/Kazan dialect mix from deportation + labour migration layers.

ekguru.recommendation: watch — Meskhetian community + Turkey-ties demand; a pan-Turkish course would subsume (not planned).

languages.name: Turkish
languages.notes: Mostly Meskhetian Turks (deportee community, south) + recent Turkey-linked migrants. Istanbul standard in schools/media; Meskhetian dialect at home — diglossia note, not a split.

ekguru.recommendation: none — inventoried only; unique script story, tiny base. Shared with KG entry.

languages.name: Dungan
languages.notes: THRESHOLD EXCEPTION (~70k L1): the world's only Cyrillic-script Sinitic language, compact high-retention villages (Sortobe/Masanchi, Zhambyl). Hui-Muslim ancestry, Gansu/Shaanxi roots. Cross-border planning unit with KG (~130k combined).

ekguru.recommendation: watch — Baku standard; small KZ base, real planning keys off the AZ entry (future batch).

languages.name: Azerbaijani
languages.notes: Code 'azj' = NORTH Azerbaijani (Latin); distinct from Iranian South (azb, Perso-Arabic) — same split class as pan/pnb. Semi-dispersed south + cities.

ekguru.recommendation: none — inventoried only.

languages.name: Kazakhstani Sign Language
languages.notes: No ISO code; Soviet boarding-school legacy means heavy Russian-SL influence. Almaty/Astana varieties. Verify pass 2 (WFD/KZ deaf orgs).
